answer: An identity gains weight only by binding one titled asset. The registry is the bridge between the on-chain identity and the off-chain title: it checks owner matches applicant, rejects any title claimed, and records the binding as one vertex in the graph, one title per identity. Each fake costs its own asset worth at least 3,000 units, a 120-unit transfer fee, and a 30-day wait before weight activates, so 100 fakes cost 312,000 units. Cheating fails: one asset cannot vine across identities, since duplicates are rejected and each resale needs a new title, another fee, and another 30-day wait.
